description: On-demand subtitle provider backed by sub.wyzie.io.
name: Wyzie Subtitles
overview: Streams subtitle content directly from Wyzie when playback starts. Requires a free API key from https://sub.wyzie.io/redeem.

versions.changelog:
Release 1.0.5

- Migrate plugin catalog to gh-pages via jellyfin-plugin-repo-action
- Build for Jellyfin 12.0 only (drop Emby and Jellyfin 10.11 targets)
- Move packaging script to scripts/package.py and add test.yaml CI workflow
- Adopt extractsubs workflow model (release/test/codeql) on main branch
